title: Government wanted as many crashes as possible to harvest technology

tellings.quote: messed up? Well, there's I heard accounts saying that the government wanted as many crashes as possible so they could harvest as much technology.

plain: The claim is that the US government wanted as many crashes of unknown craft as possible, so it could collect as much of their technology as it could. A scientist named John Brandenburg, who argues that Mars once held life wiped out by nuclear war, says this to Michels and puts it as accounts he has heard, without saying from whom. If true, it would mean crashes were welcomed as a source of hardware rather than treated as accidents.
